entries.en: to raise children; to nurture
to raise children
entries.notes: 闽南栏声调标注污损（T99），字义据西、汉、官三栏定为养育孩子。

entries.zh: 发；生长出（发荣结果、出产物事）
entries.en: to put forth; produce (things, fruit, etc.); sprout
to produce; give rise to; bear (young)
to rear children; nurture

entries.zh: 饲养；养育（喂养牲畜、抚育子女）
entries.en: to feed and raise (animals and children)
to mouth-feed; chew food for an infant
entries.notes: 闽南栏声调标注污损（T99）；哺喂之义据西、汉、官三栏互证。

entries.en: to bring up and provide for children
to change, transform; produce by transformation
entries.notes: 西语栏文字异常（criar con deios），据汉、闽、官三栏定为变化之义。

entries.zh: 造化如神（字面「法大」，确切对应存疑）
entries.en: to create as God does
entries.notes: 汉字「法大」与西语 criar como Dios 的对应不明，释义以西语栏为主轴照录。

entries.en: to raise and nurture children
to raise and feed children
to nurse; feed a child with milk
entries.notes: 闽南、官话栏声调多处污损（T99），附件 ny./L./Ley. 不明；哺乳之义据西、汉字栏互证。

entries.zh: 以乳哺人（乳母哺养他人）
entries.en: to nurse a person with one's milk (act as wet-nurse)
entries.notes: 闽南、官话栏声调污损（T99）；以乳哺养之义据西、汉字栏互证。

entries.zh: 如乳母般抚育小孩（饲小子）
entries.en: to rear a child as a wet-nurse (ama) does
entries.notes: 闽南栏声调标注污损（T99）；乳母抚育之义据西、汉、官栏互证。

entries.zh: 嚼食哺喂小孩（奶妈式口哺）
entries.en: to mouth-feed a child pre-chewed food (as an ama does)
entries.notes: 闽南栏声调两处污损（T99）；嚼哺之义据西、汉、官栏互证。

entries.en: to grow up until very big; be raised to full growth
entries.notes: 汉字栏「郎」字有[疑:郎/即]标记；养大之义据西语栏与汉字栏互证。

entries.en: [original damaged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺（criar ma[残]ho），汉字栏「上薄」有[疑:薄/薦]标记，四栏无法互证定夺。

entries.en: to grow a beard; sprout whiskers
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺（criar ma[残]ho）；据汉、闽、官三栏「生鬚」定为长须之义。

entries.zh: 喂猪（以粪料饲养猪只；养猪）
entries.en: to feed and raise pigs
entries.notes: 汉字栏「糞」字有[疑:糞/料]标记；喂猪之义据西语栏 criar puercos 定夺。

entries.zh: 手上长出硬皮（胼胝癣癞之属）
entries.en: to develop calluses (hardened skin) on the hands
entries.notes: 汉字栏「癬」字有[疑:癬/癩]标记且声调多处污损（T99）；手生硬皮之义据西语栏定夺。
